bodyText:
The apocalypse has begun, and you are stepping into a dangerous world. Before you dive in, you can use **Customize Player** to shape the roleplay version of your character that other main characters can remember.

Once you are ready, head to the **Main Menu** and start taking on **Missions** to gain strength, gather resources, and push your campaign forward.

Check your squad's gear before you deploy, and take on challenges that fit your current strength.

# Good luck!
